findings.title: Service also selects another workload's pods
findings.cause: Service shop selects pods with app=shop, which matches Deployment worker as well as Deployment web: its 1 ready pod do not declare port 8080, yet a numeric targetPort makes them endpoints too, so about 1 in 3 connections to the Service reach a pod that does not serve it

evidence.what: Service shop has selector app=shop and targetPort 8080
evidence.command: kubectl get service shop -n kd-service-selects-other-workload -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}{" "}{.spec.ports}'

evidence.what: the pods the selector matches, with their labels
pod worker-858b8dd46b-9mrqv is selected and does not declare port 8080
evidence.command: kubectl get pod worker-858b8dd46b-9mrqv -n kd-service-selects-other-workload -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[*].ports}'

findings.fix: Give the Service a selector only its own pods match: add a label that tells the workloads apart (for example a component label) to the pod templates and to Service shop's selector.
